runId.description: Run on whose behalf this handoff is made; MUST be set when emitted in the context of a Run. (RFC 018)

correlationId.description: SHOULD match the correlation field of the corresponding appendEvent records. (RFC 018)

capabilityTokenRef.description: tokenId of the capability token (capability-token.schema.json) the receiving workload operates under. The handoff record is not a credential: setting this field does not grant the token, and the receiver must present the token and pass the ordinary use-time checks (bearer subject, unexpired, unrevoked, delegator still entitled). Attenuation stays in the token's scope and delegation. (RFC 018)

budgetRef.description: BudgetPolicy.budgetId of the allocation (from allocateBudget) the handed-off work draws against; not a usage-meter id. (RFC 018)
